fields.Name: T357 - Realtime Recordings List and Empty State
fields.Description: Exercises the LoadData() RunView on 'MJ: AI Agent Sessions' filtered by RecordingFileID plus the row projection and the two mutually-exclusive master-pane branches (populated list vs the 'No recorded sessions yet' empty state) — a bespoke dashboard render, not the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Realtime Recordings' application (its default 'Recordings' screen). Wait for it to finish loading — pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait and do NOT navigate away. Success is that the Realtime Recordings surface renders its master list of recorded sessions (each row showing an agent name plus a date/time, and optionally a duration or conversation) OR a clear empty state such as 'No recorded sessions yet' — either outcome is a pass. You do NOT need to play anything.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Realtime Recordings screen loads with its 'Realtime Recordings' title/header and a circle-play icon
Either a list of recorded-session rows is shown (agent name + date, optionally duration/conversation) OR a clear empty state like 'No recorded sessions yet' is displayed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
